info.title: Terminus UI
info.description:
The HTTP API of Terminus UI, generated from the same route table the server runs.

Every endpoint is scoped to the caller's workspace (tenant): reads filter by it and
writes stamp it from the session, never from the request, so no parameter here can
reach another workspace's data. Authentication is the `session` cookie set by
/api/auth/login. Every response carries `x-request-id`; quote it in a bug report and
it finds the one access-log line for that call.
